notes.text: Game: Edit order is now a pencil button right beside “Batting order”.
Phones show the whole batting order by default. “Show just the next 3” shortens it.

Team logo and colours: Settings › Team setup › Team info › Logo and colours. The logo shows at the top of the screen and in the team list, and the header takes the team's colour. Buttons keep the Diamond DJ blue and gold.
Admin › Teams: every team at a glance (players, team songs, whether it has changes to publish, its organizers), with buttons to open its setup, logo and colours, or Google Drive folder.
Add a team in three steps: name and look, start empty or copy another team's music, and who has access. Publishing it makes the team's Google Drive folder and shares it with the people you added.

Admin › People: see who has access, add volunteers, team organizers and Admins (Google emails them a link), change roles or remove someone. Warns about anyone who can't get the common songs and folders anyone with the link can open, with a one-tap fix.
A different part of a common song for one player: Roster › Different part for this player. The song stays the same for everyone else.
Team setup and Admin have a simpler header: plain tabs in their own row, with the one you're on underlined in gold. They fit on a phone.

Publish moved to Settings › Publish, like Rinkside DJ: each team you look after (and the common songs, for the Admin) with what changed and a Publish button. A gold dot on the gear, and a note at the top of Team setup and Admin, mean something is waiting.
Phones: the Music categories wrap into rows, so every category is on screen with no sideways scrolling, and the one you pick stays in view.
Music on the Game screen: colour-coded categories (Warm-up, Pitchers, Crowd favourites, Post-game celebrations). Tap a song to play it, tap again to fade. Played songs are dimmed until New game.
Shuffle in each category plays a song not played yet this game.

Team organizers add their team's songs to a category, or hide one, in Settings › Team setup › Music. The Diamond DJ Admin names, colours and orders the categories and adds common songs in Settings › Admin › Music categories.
Key moments and breaks are gone, so the Game screen is just walk-ups and Music. On a phone: Walk-ups and Music tabs.
A simpler Game screen on phones and tablets: just the team, Lock, Help and Settings across the top. Everything for playing music stays on the Game screen.
Settings › Manage: Lineups, Team setup and Admin (for those roles) are now at the top of Settings.
Settings is grouped into Updates, Sound, This device and Advanced. Tap a group to open it.
The demo team is gone from Settings, and New game lives on the Game screen only.
Three roles, from Google Drive sharing: Diamond DJ Admin (the whole Diamond DJ folder), Team organizer (their team's folder) and Volunteer (view only). Volunteers see Game and Lineup only.
The Team screen (Team button, for team organizers): Roster & walk-ups, Team songs (pitcher music, team favourites), Moments, Team info and Publish.
The Admin screen (Admin button, for the Diamond DJ Admin): common songs and common moments for every team, and Publish for the common library.
Common moments come from the Diamond DJ Admin. A team can hide the ones it doesn't use, add its own songs to one, and make its own team moments.
Settings › Your role › View as: the Diamond DJ Admin can try the Team organizer and Volunteer screens on one device.
Publish warns you if someone else published after this device last got the team or library, with Get latest first.
Install Diamond DJ and Help and what's new are now at the top of Settings.
Help: tap the ? at the top for a game-day checklist, answers to common questions and a link to the full guide. It works while the app is locked, too.
Full guide: every question step by step, for Android tablets, phones and iPad. It opens in your browser and works without wifi.
Settings › This device › Install Diamond DJ puts the app on your home screen with the Bees icon. If your device can't do it in one tap, it shows you the steps.
What's new and App history in Help: see what changed in each version.
When a new version is ready, a message tells you what's in it, with Update now and Later. It waits until nothing is playing. Small fixes install by themselves.
